# Autolyse

An autolyse is a rest taken after flour and water are combined and before
salt and leavening are mixed in. During the rest the flour hydrates and the
gluten network begins to form on its own, so a dough needs much less hard
kneading later on.^[raw/articles/the-science-of-a-good-loaf.md]

## Why it matters

- Gives the flour time to hydrate fully before any kneading starts.
- Lets enzymes begin breaking down starches while the dough simply rests.
- Shortens the work the dough still needs, which keeps the crumb open.
